currentUserGoal: Break up the Memory Web's regular repeating layout and make the permanent progression overview feel more varied, organic, and visually engaging.
workCompleted: Replaced the straight helper spine and repeated five-satellite template with an explicit meandering progression path and eight distinct helper-cluster silhouettes.
Added visual scale hierarchy so helper unlocks, the Field Heir, and capstones read more strongly than numeric rank nodes.
Added one static Memory contour graphics layer with deterministic irregular colored territories and buds around each helper family.
Changed straight progression lines into gently curved cached QuadraticBezier paths; hover and purchase refreshes reuse the cached points without allocating.
Kept every progression connector geometrically uncrossed and every node center at least 105 world units from every other node.
Added regression coverage for unique cluster silhouettes, node spacing, visual hierarchy, graph bounds, and non-crossing connectors.
Fixed a compact-height Memory detail overlap found during screenshot verification by moving explanatory copy into the portrait's right-hand column.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 123 Vitest tests across 17 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused EcosystemMemoryTree suite passed five tests covering the 54-node graph, bounds, prerequisites, geometric crossings, distinct silhouettes, minimum spacing, and scale hierarchy.
The live compact Fit view was screenshot-verified in the in-app browser after forcing Game Over.
The selected Tiny Sprinkler detail card remained readable with no description/status collision at the compact viewport.
Browser diagnostics contained no errors or warnings.
The Memory Grove held 144 FPS with no frame spikes, 741 display objects, and about 0.05 ms average frame work.

release.status: Local ecosystem prototype checkpoint; not pushed, merged into master, or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The organic Memory Web implementation, tests, and this handoff belong in one focused local commit on codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless the user explicitly requests it.
The local Vite server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173.
knownIssues: Locked late-game clusters remain deliberately subdued at Fit zoom; the user should judge whether their contrast feels mysterious or merely too dark.
The current 54-node web has room to expand, but every new branch should receive an explicit cluster position instead of reviving generated repeated templates.
The production sequence is still mostly linear even though its visual route now meanders; future cross-links must be designed carefully to preserve the no-crossing contract.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user hands-on inspect Fit, zoom, pan, hover, and purchase behavior on the new Memory Web.
If the composition is approved, continue with the first Field Mouse resource-chain objective and visible production activity.
When adding new Memories, extend the explicit thematic territories and the spacing/crossing tests together.
doNotRevert: Keep helper families on explicit asymmetric layouts; do not regenerate them from one repeated rank-position template.
Keep connector paths cached and the territory artwork inside one static Graphics object.
Keep unlock nodes visually dominant over numeric rank nodes.
Keep the no-crossing and minimum-spacing regression tests.
Keep compact Memory detail copy in the right-hand portrait column to avoid vertical overlap.
